Spicy pork belly pizza

Koen230 min30 min1 hour

Very scrumptious pizza with Korean flavors.

Pork Belly Marinade

  • 300 g sliced pork belly
  • 30 ml soy sauce
  • 8 g sugar
  • 4 g gochugaru

Vodka Cream Sauce

  • 15 ml olive oil
  • 5 g garlic (1 small clove), minced
  • 10 g gochujang
  • 15 ml vodka
  • 45 ml heavy cream
  • 60 g tomato sauce

Pizza Assembly

  • 1 pizza dough 250–280 g
  • 75 g fresh mozzarella torn
  • 50 g low-moisture mozzarella grated
  • 20 g scallions, thinly sliced about 2 scallions
  1. Marinate the Pork Belly: Combine pork belly, soy sauce, sugar, and gochugaru. Mix well and refrigerate, covered, for up to 24 hours.
  2. Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Fry the marinated pork belly until browned and slightly crispy. Set aside.
  3. In a small saucepan, heat olive oil. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant (30–60 seconds). Stir in gochujang and cook briefly. Pour in vodka and let it reduce for about 1 minute. Add heavy cream and tomato sauce. Simmer on low heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and slightly thickened.
  4. Preheat oven to 250°C. Roll out the dough and place on a hot pizza stone or baking tray. Par-bake for 5 minutes.
  5. Assemble the Pizza: Spread a thin layer of vodka sauce over the par-baked crust. Top with cooked pork belly. Scatter fresh and low-moisture mozzarella evenly.
  6. Return the pizza to the oven and bake until cheese is bubbling and crust is golden and crisp.
  7. Finish with sliced scallions. Let cool for 1–2 minutes before slicing.
